record.one_liner: Jira Cloud provides a comprehensive REST API to plan, track, and manage work items, supporting OAuth 2.0 (3LO), basic authentication, and app frameworks like Forge and Connect.

auth_methods.quote: For Connect apps, authentication (JWT-based) is built into the Connect libraries. ... use OAuth 2.0 authorization code grants (3LO) for security ... use basic authentication.

access_test.quote: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) apps are created and managed in the developer console. From any page on developer.atlassian.com, select your profile icon in the top-right corner, and from the dropdown, select Developer console.

access_ship.quote: Build the future of agile work management with Jira Cloud Jira Cloud is built for every member of your software team to plan, track, and manage their work.
